candidates.rationale: Classic call to trust God with all your heart and not lean on your own understanding when the path is unclear.
Job affirms trust in God even when he cannot understand why his suffering is happening.
God's ways and thoughts are higher than ours, reminding us that clarity is not a prerequisite for trust.
Paul writes that we walk by faith, not by sight—trusting even when we cannot see or understand.
Faith is defined as confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see or fully understand.
